protocol.frozen_models: C65 two-seed onset classifiers and original ongoing reference;no classifier/ranker refit
protocol.count_features: 24 whole-window summaries of legal existing features,link-ID sorted,final lead30 metadata. No fit in-sample probabilities,labels or future quality input.
protocol.count_targets: Observed eligible positive count;adjusted count=count*N/eligible_count under unverified MCAR assumption. log1p Ridge alpha10,fit-only feature mean/std,no scaling grid;prior is adjusted-target intercept-only control.
protocol.count_decoding: expm1 clipped to[0,N],floor(value+.5),clamp1..N;predicted count is not latent truth. Three states/case,two Ridge and one scalar control.
protocol.threshold: Decision only,prefer no force and threshold closer.5 on exact tie
protocol.decision: Max decision proxy over fixed candidate order,incumbent first;count models have no decision tuning
protocol.selection: Later15days:decision winner replaces incumbent only if origin-macro gain>=.01 and7day-block95CI lower>0
protocol.assessment: Previously viewed public observation proxy dates;C67 label-oracle diagnostics not read by this program or used in fitting/decoding. Not blind/final/private.
protocol.scope: Only onset final step changes;ongoing exactly frozen. Fit->count seal->decision->decision seal->selection->selection seal->assessment.
